metadata.description: Kamleshwar Dodiyar, the Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Sailana constituency in Madhya Pradesh, gained widespread recognition as the state's poorest MLA. Hailing from the Bhil tribe, Dodiyar's journey into politics is marked by his humble beginnings and deep connection to his community. In an exclusive interview with Shyam Sunder, the editor of Main Bhi Bharat, Dodiyar shared his insights on the current political landscape. He expressed that the Modi government's reliance on coalition partners would likely prevent it from touching contentious issues such as the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) and the delisting of converted tribals.
